description: Defines an abstract class 'Wrapper' used as a base for code generation components, managing context, language, and section masks for code generation tasks within the project.

classes.name: Wrapper
classes.description: An abstract class providing context and configuration for code generation, including language and section masks, and flags indicating list or map participation.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the associated BaseVariable instance.

methods.name: getSectionMask
methods.description: Returns the section mask indicating sections referencing this wrapper.

methods.name: getLanguageMask
methods.description: Retrieves the language mask specifying target languages for code generation.

methods.name: getContextJava
methods.description: Provides the Java context for code generation.

methods.name: getContextNative
methods.description: Provides the native (C) context for code generation.

methods.name: isInList
methods.description: Indicates whether this wrapper is part of a list.

methods.name: isInMap
methods.description: Indicates whether this wrapper is part of a map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the variable if available, otherwise default object string.
